# CesiumJS 1.146.0

The `Build/Cesium` folder of the [cesium](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cesium) npm package, version 1.146.0,
unchanged except that files these cards don't use are left out: `index.js` and `index.cjs` (module copies of
`Cesium.js`), `Assets/Textures/maki` and `Assets/Textures/NaturalEarthII`.

CesiumJS is Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE.md`); its third-party libraries and their licenses are listed in
`ThirdParty.json`. Updated with `vendor-cesium.sh` in the ha-cards repo.
